items.title: Zelensky says Ukraine is ready for an energy ceasefire with Russia
items.description: On the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York on Tuesday, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky told journalists that Kyiv is ready to halt strikes on Russian energy infrastructure if Moscow does the same, with hopes to end the war before winter.

items.title: Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list
items.description: Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman both have close ties to President Putin, and Kyiv said the move sent Moscow the wrong signals.

items.title: EU removes two oligarchs reputedly close to Putin from sanctions list
items.description: At France and Luxembourg's request, the EU removed Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman from its list of sanctioned individuals, which was otherwise renewed for three years. Ukraine called the decision 'unacceptable.'

items.title: ‘Nowhere is safe’: UN experts detail Ukraine war’s toll and Russia’s reach beyond its borders
items.description: UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts on Monday laid out a grim picture of the human cost of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, with a spotlight on civilians facing a third wartime winter as well as the intimidation of Russians who have fled abroad.

items.title: Frontline Update, Lyman Details, AFU Reorganization
items.description: The front line has moved in Ukraine’s favor in the northern Lyman sector, whereas the southern city of Orikhiv, in the Zaporizhzhia region, is bracing itself for an expected Russian push. Meanwhile the Dopropillya sector remains one of the hottest, with the 1st Corps honing its drone buzz saw under serious pressure.
